description: NaDyH₂S₂O₉ crystallizes in the trigonal P3_121 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.42 Å) and two longer (2.59 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Dy is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Dy-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.52 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.51 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Dy, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Dy and two equivalent H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Dy, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Dy, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Dy and one S atom.
